findings.evidence: Every state that fetches GET http://127.0.0.1:8766/api/admin/stock/low-alerts (03,04,05,06,06a — 9 total occurrences) logs a console entry: level='info', text="Connecting to 'http://127.0.0.1:8766/api/admin/stock/low-alerts' violates the following Content Security Policy directive: connect-src 'self' ws: wss: https: http://127.0.0.1:9100 http://localhost:9100. The policy is report-only, so the violation has been logged but no further action has been taken." (verified via python3 json.load + filter on all 8 *.console.json, not grep-pathological-regex). This is filed with explicit caveats: (1) level is 'info', not 'error' — category 9's literal detection rule ('entry with level=error') is NOT met, so this does not qualify as a scored P1 console_error under REVIEWER_PROTOCOL's letter, consistent with the same literal-reading discipline round-1 applied to E-001/E-002. (2) The policy is report-only (confirmed by the browser's own log text) so the request is NOT blocked — all corresponding network.json files show zero 4xx/5xx/slow entries for this URL, i.e. the fetch succeeds despite the logged violation. (3) Filed at P3 purely as an owner-visibility config-drift item: the CSP connect-src allowlist enumerates the print-bridge ports (127.0.0.1:9100/localhost:9100) but not the API host 127.0.0.1:8766 that both StockLowAlertsWidget.vue and PosComponent.vue call directly (cross-origin from the 8000-served page). If this CSP is ever flipped from Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only to enforcing, both stock-alert fetches would break silently (same failure family as E-001/E-002, this time via CSP block instead of 403) with zero visible UI signal, since both call sites already swallow errors into count=0/alerts=[] without a toast. Not blocking this round's verdict (P3, non-functional today) but worth tracking before any CSP-hardening pass.
findings.fix_hint: Add http://127.0.0.1:8766 (and its https/prod equivalent) to connect-src in the CSP config alongside the existing 9100/9101 bridge entries, before ever promoting the policy from report-only to enforcing.
